description:
Import the S1223 airfoil from '~/Documents/airfoils/s1223.dat' into QBlade. This raw airfoil file requires geometric pre-processing before it can be used for simulation. 

Perform the following operations in the Airfoil Design module:
1. 'Normalize' the airfoil (Scale chord to 1, origin at LE).
2. 'De-rotate' the airfoil (Align chord with x-axis).
3. 'Refine Globally' to set the number of panels to exactly 160.
4. 'Set T.E. Gap' to 0.4% chord (Value: 0.004) with a blend distance of 0.2.

Finally, export the processed airfoil to '~/Documents/airfoils/s1223_modified.dat' using 'Export Airfoil'.
